trial_court: Family Court No.1, Jodhpur Metropolitan (Civil Case No.158/2022) and Family Court, Pali (Divorce Petition under Section 13 and 25 of HMA)
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized in 2015. Differences arose, husband filed for dissolution of marriage, wife preferred divorce petition. Both parties pray for transfer of proceedings to their respective locations.

legal_principles.principle: When petitions are presented to different District Courts, the petition presented later shall be transferred to the District Court in which the earlier petition was presented and both the petitions shall be heard and disposed of together.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that it is an admitted position that the husband has preferred the petition for dissolution of marriage on 17.02.2022 and the wife has preferred the divorce petition on 25.03.2022, i.e., after approximately 53 days.

legal_principles.principle: The power of the court under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code to transfer a suit or an appeal or other proceeding applies to an application for divorce filed under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Before proceeding further, it is pertinent to consider that whether the power of this Court under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code to transfer a suit or an appeal or other proceeding applies to an application for divorce filed under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act or not.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings initiated by the other spouse are transferred to the place where each application is pending.
